title: Thymosin β4 alleviates renal fibrosis and tubular cell apoptosis through TGF-β pathway inhibition in UUO rat models

citation.title: Thymosin β4 alleviates renal fibrosis and tubular cell apoptosis through TGF-β pathway inhibition in UUO rat models

printed_heading.text: RESEARCH ARTICLE Open Access Thymosin β4 alleviates renal fibrosis and tubular cell apoptosis through TGF-β pathway inhibition in UUO rat models Jing Yuan, Yan Shen, Xia Yang, Ying Xie, Xin Lin, Wen Zeng, Yingting Zhao, Maolu Tian and Yan Zha*

what_it_measured.text: This study aimed to examine the effects of Tβ4 on the renal apoptosis and the expression of transforming growth factor (TGF-β), E-cadherin, and α-smooth muscle actin (α-SMA) in CRTIF rat models.
Therefore, this study aimed to examine the effects of different doses of Tβ4 on CRTIF and on the expression of TGF-β, E-cadherin, and α-SMA.

dose.text: Tubular epithelial cells were stimulated with 2.5 ng/ml TGF-β for 72 h in the TGF-βgroup,1μg/ml Tβ4 and 5μg/ml Tβ4 in the low dose Tβ4 group and high dose Tβ4 group for 48 h after TGF-β treated cells, respectively.

The rats were randomized to the sham group (n = 15), unilateral ureteral obstruction (UUO) group (n = 15), UUO + low-dose Tβ4 (1 mg/kg•d) group (n = 15), and UUO + high-dose Tβ4 (5 mg/kg•d) group (n = 15).

endpoint.text: Cell apoptosis of rat renal interstitial tissue and tubular epithelial cells was evaluated by immunofluorescence and western blot.
The pathological changes of kidney tissue and its function were assessed two weeks after UUO.
area ratio of fibrosis and total interstitial tissue was measured in each field.

reported_results.text: Compared to the UUO group, Tβ4 treatment decreased the 24-h proteinuria (P < 0.001) and reduced the area of pathological change (P < 0.01); this effect was more apparent in the UUO + high-dose Tβ4 group.
Results: Two weeks after UUO, no differences in blood urea nitrogen and creatinine were observed between the four groups (P > 0.05).
The expression of α-SMA mRNA in the TGF-β + low-dose Tβ4 group was markedly decreased (Fig. 4b P < 0.05).
The number of apoptosis cells in the TGF-β + low-dose Tβ4 group was markedly decreased (Fig. 6a, b P < 0.05).
The expression of α-SMA in the TGF-β + low-dose Tβ4 group was markedly decreased (P < 0.05).
Tβ4 group compared to the low-dose group (Fig. 6a, b P < 0.05).
